title: vitis himalayana var. semicordata
intro: Vitis himalayana var. semicordata, commonly known as Himalayan grape, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region, belonging to the Vitaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Vitis himalayana var. semicordata include analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant effects, which contribute to its use in treating pain, fever, and cough. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
